newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss hotel stays down in January-September 1996.
newsitem.headline: Swiss hotel stays down in January-September 1996.

text.p: Overnight stays in Swiss hotels were down 5.3 percent in the first nine months of 1996 compared with the same 1995 period, the Swiss Federal Statistics Office said.
Overnight hotel stays for the first nine months of 1996 totaled 24.495 million, it said. For September alone, overnight stays totaled 2.886 million and were 5.1 percent below 1995.

A good portion of the decline was attributed to a drop in foreign guests, the Office said. The largest single decline was registered in the number of German guest stays, it said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
